name: Shivapur
description: Farming hub along the Pune-Satara highway with rich loam and vegetable farming.

name: Khed-Shivapur
description: Neighboring village (~4.5 km away) growing tomatoes, maize and vegetables.

name: Saswad
description: Famous for onion, tomato and fig horticulture (~7.2 km from Shivapur cluster).

name: Shirur
description: Semi-arid northern taluka (>65 km away) primarily growing sugarcane and cotton.

name: Baramati
description: Eastern taluka (>70 km away) with canal network, wheat and cotton cultivation.
